bibl.title: The Latin of the Thracian soldier Cutus
bibl.seg: James N. Adams & Rodney Ast, The Latin of the Thracian Soldier Cutus.
bibl.note: Nine Latin ostraca found in the fort of Didymoi associated with a Thracian soldier named Cutus. - The 'hand' of Cutus. - Onomastics and Prosopography. - Language. - 1. O. Did. 334. Letter of Cutus to Drozeus. c. 88-96. - 2. O. Did. 335. Letter of Cutus to Tarula. c. 88-96. - 3. O. Did. 336. Incomplete Letter. c. 77-92. - 4. O. Did. Inv. D217-CSA 246. Document Mentioning Mucatrha and Cornelius. c. 78-85. - 5. O. Did. Inv. D218-CSA 247. Fragment of a Letter. c. 78-85. - 6. O. Did. Inv. D746-CSA 828. Fragmentary Letter. c. 88-96. - 7. O. Did. Inv. D838-CSA 920. Fragment with the Name Gaius. c. 77-92. - 8. Inv. D861-CSA 949. Fragmentary Document. c. 77-92. - 9. O. Did. 63. A Liste of Squadrons and Soldiers. c. 88-96. - Conclusions.
